kidney.en: The biology lesson explained how each kidney helps filter the blood.
kidney.zh: 生物課說明每個腎臟如何協助過濾血液。

kilogram.en: The package weighed one kilogram before the shop added extra wrapping.
kilogram.zh: 商店加上額外包裝前，包裹重一公斤。

kilometer.en: The hiking trail continues for another kilometer beyond the wooden bridge.
kilometer.zh: 這條健行步道在木橋之後還延伸一公里。

kin.en: The old records helped her identify distant kin from another town.
kin.zh: 舊紀錄幫助她找出住在另一座城鎮的遠親。

kindergarten.en: My cousin started kindergarten and quickly made several new friends.
kindergarten.zh: 我的表弟開始上幼兒園後很快就交了幾個新朋友。

kindle.en: A good science book can kindle curiosity about the natural world.
kindle.zh: 一本好科普書可以激發人們對自然世界的好奇心。

kingdom.en: The museum exhibit describes how the ancient kingdom expanded its trade.
kingdom.zh: 博物館展覽說明這個古代王國如何擴展貿易。

kit.en: The first-aid kit was stored beside the door for emergencies.
kit.zh: 急救包放在門邊，以便緊急時使用。

kite.en: The bright kite rose steadily as the wind became stronger.
kite.zh: 隨著風勢變強，那只鮮豔的風箏穩定升高。

kneel.en: The photographer had to kneel to capture the flower closely.
kneel.zh: 攝影師必須跪下來，才能近距離拍攝那朵花。

knight.en: The novel follows a young knight on a long journey home.
knight.zh: 這本小說描述一名年輕騎士踏上漫長返鄉旅程。

knit.en: My grandmother likes to knit scarves during quiet winter evenings.
knit.zh: 我的祖母喜歡在安靜的冬夜織圍巾。

knob.en: Turn the silver knob gently to open the old cabinet.
knob.zh: 輕輕轉動銀色旋鈕，就能打開舊櫥櫃。

knot.en: He tied a firm knot so the rope would stay secure.
knot.zh: 他打了一個牢固的結，讓繩子保持固定。

knowledgeable.en: The guide was knowledgeable about the history of the mountain village.
knowledgeable.zh: 那位導覽員非常了解這座山村的歷史。

koala.en: The zoo sign explained why a koala spends hours resting.
koala.zh: 動物園告示說明無尾熊為何會花很多時間休息。

lab.en: Students wore safety goggles before entering the chemistry lab.
lab.zh: 學生進入化學實驗室前先戴上護目鏡。

lace.en: She replaced the broken lace on her running shoe.
lace.zh: 她把跑鞋上斷掉的鞋帶換掉了。

lad.en: The story describes a cheerful lad who helps his neighbors.
lad.zh: 故事描述一名開朗少年幫助鄰居的情節。

ladder.en: The worker placed the ladder firmly against the wall.
ladder.zh: 工人把梯子穩穩靠在牆上。

ladybug.en: A small ladybug landed on the leaf beside my notebook.
ladybug.zh: 一隻小瓢蟲停在我筆記本旁的葉子上。

lag.en: A weak connection can cause noticeable lag during an online lesson.
lag.zh: 網路連線不穩可能讓線上課程出現明顯延遲。

lamb.en: The young lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.zh: 小羊在田野裡一直靠近母羊。

lamp.en: I switched on the desk lamp to finish reading my notes.
lamp.zh: 我打開檯燈，好把筆記讀完。

landlady.en: The landlady explained the apartment rules before handing over the key.
landlady.zh: 女房東交鑰匙前先說明公寓規定。

landlord.en: The landlord repaired the leaking faucet after receiving our message.
landlord.zh: 房東收到我們的訊息後修理了漏水的水龍頭。

landmark.en: The old tower remains a famous landmark in the city center.
landmark.zh: 那座古塔仍是市中心著名的地標。

landslide.en: Heavy rain increased the risk of a landslide near the mountain road.
landslide.zh: 大雨提高了山路附近發生土石滑動的風險。

lane.en: Cyclists should remain in the marked lane whenever possible.
lane.zh: 自行車騎士應盡量留在標示的車道內。

lantern.en: A red lantern hung above the entrance during the festival.
lantern.zh: 節慶期間，一盞紅燈籠掛在入口上方。

lap.en: The runner completed one final lap before leaving the track.
lap.zh: 那名跑者完成最後一圈後離開跑道。

largely.en: The project succeeded largely because everyone shared clear responsibilities.
largely.zh: 這個計畫能成功，主要是因為每個人都有明確分工。

laser.en: The science teacher demonstrated how a laser produces a narrow beam.
laser.zh: 科學老師示範雷射如何產生狹窄光束。

lash.en: Strong waves began to lash the empty pier during the storm.
lash.zh: 暴風雨期間，強浪開始猛烈拍打空蕩的碼頭。

lately.en: I have been reading more historical novels lately after school.
lately.zh: 我最近放學後讀了更多歷史小說。

latitude.en: The map shows the latitude of each major city clearly.
latitude.zh: 地圖清楚標示每個主要城市的緯度。

latter.en: Between the two plans, the latter seems easier to complete.
latter.zh: 在兩個方案之中，後者看起來比較容易完成。

laughter.en: Warm laughter filled the classroom after the teacher told a joke.
laughter.zh: 老師說完笑話後，教室裡充滿愉快笑聲。

laundry.en: I folded the clean laundry before starting my homework.
laundry.zh: 我先把洗好的衣物摺好，才開始寫作業。

lavish.en: The palace contained lavish rooms decorated with carved wooden panels.
lavish.zh: 宮殿裡有裝飾華麗、帶有木雕牆板的房間。

lawful.en: The judge explained why the decision was lawful under current rules.
lawful.zh: 法官說明這項決定為何符合現行法律。

lawmaker.en: Each lawmaker received a copy of the proposed environmental bill.
lawmaker.zh: 每位立法者都收到一份擬議環境法案。

lawn.en: Children played on the wide lawn beside the community center.
lawn.zh: 孩子們在活動中心旁的大片草地上玩耍。

lawsuit.en: The article summarized the lawsuit without taking either side.
lawsuit.zh: 這篇文章中立地摘要了這起訴訟。

layer.en: A thin layer of ice covered the sidewalk early this morning.
layer.zh: 今天一早，人行道上覆著一層薄冰。

layman.en: The scientist explained the idea in terms a layman could understand.
layman.zh: 科學家用一般人也能理解的方式解釋這個概念。

layout.en: The new layout makes the school website easier to navigate.
layout.zh: 新的版面配置讓學校網站更容易瀏覽。

lazy.en: A lazy afternoon gave us time to read and relax.
lazy.zh: 悠閒的下午讓我們有時間閱讀與放鬆。

league.en: Our school team joined a regional basketball league this semester.
league.zh: 本學期我們校隊加入了區域籃球聯盟。

leak.en: A small leak under the sink caused water to spread.
leak.zh: 水槽下方的小漏水讓水慢慢流開。

lean.en: Do not lean against the display case inside the museum.
lean.zh: 在博物館內不要靠在展示櫃上。

leap.en: The deer made a quick leap across the narrow stream.
leap.zh: 那隻鹿迅速一躍，越過狹窄的小溪。

learned.en: The learned professor answered questions with patience and clear examples.
learned.zh: 那位博學教授耐心地用清楚例子回答問題。

lease.en: They read the lease carefully before renting the small apartment.
lease.zh: 他們租下小公寓前仔細閱讀租約。

leather.en: The museum displayed an old leather bag from the expedition.
leather.zh: 博物館展出一個來自探險隊的舊皮包。

lecturer.en: The guest lecturer spoke about renewable energy and urban design.
lecturer.zh: 客座講師談到再生能源與都市設計。

legacy.en: The scientist's legacy continues through the research center she founded.
legacy.zh: 那位科學家的貢獻透過她創立的研究中心延續。

legendary.en: The book describes a legendary explorer who crossed the desert.
legendary.zh: 這本書描述一位穿越沙漠的傳奇探險家。

legislation.en: New legislation requires clearer labels on certain consumer products.
legislation.zh: 新法規要求某些消費產品使用更清楚的標示。

legislative.en: The class discussed the legislative process behind new laws.
legislative.zh: 全班討論新法律背後的立法程序。

legislator.en: The legislator attended a public meeting about transportation planning.
legislator.zh: 那位立法者出席了關於交通規劃的公開會議。

leisurely.en: We took a leisurely walk along the river after lunch.
leisurely.zh: 午餐後我們沿著河邊悠閒散步。

lemon.en: She added a slice of lemon to the glass of water.
lemon.zh: 她在那杯水裡放了一片檸檬。

lemonade.en: The students sold homemade lemonade during the school fair.
lemonade.zh: 學生在校慶園遊會販售自製檸檬汁。

lengthen.en: Adding another paragraph would lengthen the report without improving it.
lengthen.zh: 再加一段只會讓報告變長，卻不會更好。

lengthy.en: The lengthy meeting ended after everyone agreed on the schedule.
lengthy.zh: 漫長會議在大家同意時程後結束。

lens.en: The photographer cleaned the camera lens before taking the picture.
lens.zh: 攝影師拍照前先清潔相機鏡頭。

leopard.en: The documentary followed a leopard moving quietly through tall grass.
leopard.zh: 紀錄片拍攝一隻豹安靜穿過高草叢。

lessen.en: Planting trees can lessen summer heat around school buildings.
lessen.zh: 種樹可以減輕校舍周圍的夏季熱氣。

lest.en: She saved another copy lest the original file become damaged.
lest.zh: 她另外存了一份，以免原始檔案損壞。

lettuce.en: Fresh lettuce added a crisp texture to the sandwich.
lettuce.zh: 新鮮生菜讓三明治多了爽脆口感。

liability.en: The company listed the loan as a long-term liability.
liability.zh: 公司把這筆貸款列為長期負債。

liable.en: Drivers may be liable for damage caused by careless behavior.
liable.zh: 駕駛人可能要為疏忽行為造成的損害負責。

liar.en: Calling someone a liar without evidence can damage trust quickly.
liar.zh: 沒有證據就稱某人是騙子，可能很快破壞信任。

liberal.en: The course offers a liberal range of topics across the humanities.
liberal.zh: 這門課在人文領域提供相當廣泛的主題。

liberate.en: The movement hoped to liberate the region from unfair restrictions.
liberate.zh: 這場運動希望讓該地區擺脫不公平限制。

liberation.en: The museum presents liberation as an important theme in modern history.
liberation.zh: 博物館把解放呈現為近代史的重要主題。

liberty.en: The debate examined how liberty and responsibility can exist together.
liberty.zh: 辯論探討自由與責任如何同時存在。

librarian.en: The librarian helped me locate a book about climate science.
librarian.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本氣候科學的書。

license.en: The software license explains how the program may be used.
license.zh: 軟體授權說明這個程式可以如何使用。

lick.en: The puppy tried to lick the drops of water from its nose.
lick.zh: 小狗試著舔掉鼻子上的水滴。

lid.en: Please close the lid tightly before placing the container inside.
lid.zh: 把容器放進去前，請先把蓋子蓋緊。

lie.en: It is better to admit a mistake than tell a lie.

lieutenant.en: The history text mentioned a lieutenant who carried the official message.
lieutenant.zh: 歷史課本提到一名負責傳遞正式訊息的中尉。

lifeguard.en: The lifeguard watched the swimming area carefully throughout the afternoon.
lifeguard.zh: 救生員整個下午都仔細看守游泳區。

lifelong.en: Reading can become a lifelong habit that supports continuous learning.
lifelong.zh: 閱讀可以成為支持持續學習的終身習慣。

lifetime.en: The old tree may survive for more than a human lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 那棵老樹可能比人的一生還長壽。

lighten.en: Opening the curtains will lighten the room during the morning.
lighten.zh: 早上拉開窗簾會讓房間更明亮。

lighthouse.en: The lighthouse stood on a rocky point above the sea.
lighthouse.zh: 燈塔矗立在海上的岩石岬角。

lightning.en: A flash of lightning appeared before the thunder reached us.
lightning.zh: 雷聲傳來前，先出現一道閃電。

likelihood.en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain later that afternoon.
likelihood.zh: 烏雲增加了當天下午稍後下雨的可能性。

lily.en: A white lily opened beside the pond after several warm days.
lily.zh: 連續幾個溫暖日子後，池塘旁開了一朵白百合。

limb.en: A heavy tree limb fell across the path after the storm.
limb.zh: 暴風雨後，一根粗大的樹枝倒在步道上。

limitation.en: Time was the main limitation when we planned the project.
limitation.zh: 時間是我們規劃專題時最大的限制。

limp.en: The injured dog began to limp, so its owner called a veterinarian.
limp.zh: 受傷的狗開始跛行，因此主人聯絡了獸醫。

linen.en: The hotel used fresh linen on every bed in the room.
linen.zh: 旅館在房間每張床上都使用乾淨床單。

liner.en: The museum displayed photographs of a famous ocean liner.
liner.zh: 博物館展出一艘著名遠洋客輪的照片。

linger.en: The smell of fresh bread seemed to linger in the kitchen.
linger.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味似乎一直留在廚房裡。

lining.en: The coat has a warm lining that helps block cold wind.
lining.zh: 這件外套有保暖內襯，可幫助阻擋冷風。

lion.en: The lion rested in the shade during the hottest afternoon hours.
lion.zh: 獅子在午後最炎熱時待在陰影中休息。

lip.en: A small cut on his lip healed after several days.
lip.zh: 他嘴唇上的小傷口幾天後癒合了。

lipstick.en: The theater costume included bright lipstick for the stage performance.
lipstick.zh: 舞台表演的戲服造型包含鮮豔口紅。

liquid.en: Water changes from a solid to a liquid as ice melts.
liquid.zh: 冰融化時，水會從固體變成液體。

listener.en: A careful listener asks questions after understanding the main idea.
listener.zh: 細心的聽者會在理解重點後再提問。

liter.en: The bottle can hold exactly one liter of water.
liter.zh: 這個瓶子剛好可以裝一公升的水。

literacy.en: Digital literacy helps students judge whether online information is reliable.
literacy.zh: 數位素養能幫助學生判斷網路資訊是否可靠。

literal.en: A literal translation may sound unnatural in another language.
literal.zh: 逐字翻譯在另一種語言中可能聽起來不自然。

literary.en: The teacher introduced several literary techniques used in the short story.
literary.zh: 老師介紹短篇故事中使用的幾種文學技巧。

literate.en: Being media literate helps people evaluate news more carefully.
literate.zh: 具備媒體素養能幫助人們更仔細評估新聞。

litter.en: Volunteers collected litter along the riverbank on Saturday morning.
litter.zh: 志工星期六早上在河岸撿拾垃圾。

lively.en: The class became lively when students began sharing travel stories.
lively.zh: 學生開始分享旅行故事後，課堂變得很活潑。

mighty.en: The mighty river has shaped the valley for thousands of years.
mighty.zh: 這條壯闊河流數千年來塑造了山谷地形。

migrant.en: The article describes challenges faced by a migrant worker abroad.
migrant.zh: 文章描述移工在海外面臨的挑戰。

migration.en: Scientists track bird migration to understand seasonal movement patterns.
migration.zh: 科學家追蹤鳥類遷徙，以了解季節移動模式。

mike.en: The reporter adjusted the mike before the interview began.
mike.zh: 記者在訪談開始前調整麥克風。

mild.en: The weather remained mild despite several days of winter rain.
mild.zh: 儘管連續幾天下冬雨，天氣仍然溫和。

milestone.en: Finishing the research project was an important milestone for our team.
milestone.zh: 完成研究專題是我們團隊的重要里程碑。

military.en: The museum presents military history through uniforms, maps, and letters.
military.zh: 博物館透過制服、地圖與書信呈現軍事歷史。

mill.en: The old mill once used river water to power its machinery.
mill.zh: 那座老磨坊曾利用河水驅動機械。

million.en: The charity campaign raised more than one million dollars worldwide.
million.zh: 這項慈善活動在全球募得超過一百萬美元。

millionaire.en: The novel follows a millionaire who chooses a simple rural life.
millionaire.zh: 這本小說描述一名百萬富翁選擇樸實鄉村生活。

mimic.en: Some birds can mimic sounds they hear in their environment.
mimic.zh: 有些鳥可以模仿牠們在環境中聽到的聲音。

mine.en: That blue notebook is mine, so please leave it here.
mine.zh: 那本藍色筆記本是我的，請把它留在這裡。

miner.en: The documentary interviewed a retired miner about working underground.
miner.zh: 紀錄片訪問一名退休礦工，談地下工作的經驗。

mineral.en: Quartz is a common mineral found in many types of rock.
mineral.zh: 石英是許多岩石中常見的礦物。

mingle.en: Students had time to mingle after the school ceremony ended.
mingle.zh: 學校典禮結束後，學生有時間互相交流。

miniature.en: The museum displayed a miniature model of the historic station.
miniature.zh: 博物館展示那座歷史車站的縮小模型。

minimum.en: The course requires a minimum of ten hours of practice.
minimum.zh: 這門課至少需要十小時練習。

minister.en: The minister answered questions about the new education policy.
minister.zh: 部長回答有關新教育政策的問題。

ministry.en: The ministry published updated guidelines for school safety inspections.
ministry.zh: 該部會公布更新版校園安全檢查指引。

minority.en: A small minority of students chose the optional evening course.
minority.zh: 只有少數學生選擇了選修的晚間課程。

mint.en: Fresh mint gave the cold drink a clean herbal smell.
mint.zh: 新鮮薄荷讓冷飲帶有清新的草本香氣。

minus.en: Ten minus four equals six in this simple equation.
minus.zh: 在這個簡單算式中，十減四等於六。

miracle.en: The coach called the unexpected comeback a small miracle.
miracle.zh: 教練把這次意外逆轉稱為一個小奇蹟。

miraculous.en: The ancient story describes a miraculous event beside the river.
miraculous.zh: 這則古老故事描述河邊發生的一件神奇事件。

mirror.en: The old mirror reflected sunlight across the quiet room.
mirror.zh: 那面舊鏡子把陽光反射到安靜房間裡。

miscellaneous.en: The last drawer contains miscellaneous cables, batteries, and small tools.
miscellaneous.zh: 最後一個抽屜放著各式線材、電池與小工具。

mischief.en: The puppy's harmless mischief made everyone in the house laugh.
mischief.zh: 小狗無傷大雅的惡作劇逗得全家都笑了。

mischievous.en: The mischievous cat hid behind the curtain and surprised us.
mischievous.zh: 那隻調皮的貓躲在窗簾後面嚇了我們一跳。

miserable.en: The cold rain made the long outdoor wait feel miserable.
miserable.zh: 寒冷的雨讓漫長的戶外等待變得很難受。

misery.en: The novel shows how poverty brought misery to the village.
misery.zh: 小說呈現貧困如何為村莊帶來苦難。

misfortune.en: Despite the misfortune, the family rebuilt their business slowly.
misfortune.zh: 儘管遭遇不幸，那家人仍慢慢重建事業。

mislead.en: A dramatic headline can mislead readers if important context is missing.
mislead.zh: 如果缺少重要背景，誇張標題可能誤導讀者。

missing.en: The teacher noticed one missing page in the copied report.
missing.zh: 老師注意到影印報告少了一頁。

mission.en: The research team's mission is to measure air quality accurately.
mission.zh: 研究團隊的任務是準確測量空氣品質。

missionary.en: The archive contains letters written by a missionary many decades ago.
missionary.zh: 檔案館收藏一位傳教士數十年前寫的書信。

mist.en: A thin mist covered the lake early in the morning.
mist.zh: 一早湖面覆著一層薄霧。

mister.en: The child politely used mister when addressing the unfamiliar visitor.
mister.zh: 孩子禮貌地用先生稱呼那位不熟悉的訪客。

misunderstand.en: Please ask questions if you misunderstand any part of the instructions.
misunderstand.zh: 如果你誤解任何一部分說明，請提出問題。

mix.en: Use a spoon to mix the flour and water evenly.
mix.zh: 用湯匙把麵粉和水均勻混合。

mixture.en: The experiment produced a cloudy mixture after the two liquids combined.
mixture.zh: 兩種液體混合後，實驗產生了混濁的混合物。

moan.en: A low moan came from the old wooden door in the wind.
moan.zh: 風吹時，舊木門發出低沉的呻吟聲。

mob.en: The history article describes how an angry mob gathered outside.
mob.zh: 歷史文章描述憤怒群眾如何聚集在外面。

mobile.en: The library launched a mobile service for readers in rural areas.
mobile.zh: 圖書館推出行動服務，提供給偏鄉讀者。

mobilize.en: Volunteers began to mobilize supplies after the severe storm.
mobilize.zh: 嚴重暴風雨過後，志工開始動員物資。

mock.en: Students should never mock a classmate for making a mistake.
mock.zh: 學生不應因同學犯錯而嘲笑對方。

mode.en: The tablet switches to reading mode when the room becomes dark.
mode.zh: 房間變暗時，平板會切換到閱讀模式。

modernization.en: Railway modernization shortened travel time between several major cities.
modernization.zh: 鐵路現代化縮短了幾個主要城市之間的旅行時間。

modernize.en: The museum plans to modernize its ticket system next year.
modernize.zh: 博物館計畫明年更新其售票系統。

modest.en: The project began with a modest budget and simple equipment.
modest.zh: 這個計畫以不高的預算和簡單設備起步。

modesty.en: Her modesty kept her from taking all the credit herself.
modesty.zh: 她的謙虛使她沒有把所有功勞歸給自己。

moist.en: The soil remained moist after several hours of light rain.
moist.zh: 小雨下了幾小時後，土壤仍保持濕潤。

moisture.en: The container protects the paper from moisture and dust.
moisture.zh: 這個容器能保護紙張免受濕氣與灰塵影響。

molecule.en: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 一個水分子含有兩個氫原子和一個氧原子。

momentum.en: The campaign gained momentum after more students joined the project.
momentum.zh: 更多學生加入後，這項活動逐漸形成動能。

monarch.en: The portrait shows a monarch wearing traditional ceremonial clothing.
monarch.zh: 這幅肖像描繪一位穿著傳統禮服的君主。

monetary.en: The report focused on monetary policy and changes in interest rates.
monetary.zh: 這份報告聚焦貨幣政策與利率變化。

monk.en: The old painting shows a monk reading beside a window.
monk.zh: 這幅古畫描繪一名僧侶在窗邊閱讀。

monkey.en: A monkey watched visitors from a branch above the path.
monkey.zh: 一隻猴子從步道上方的樹枝看著遊客。

monopoly.en: The economics lesson explains how a monopoly can limit competition.
monopoly.zh: 經濟課說明壟斷如何限制市場競爭。

monotony.en: Music helped break the monotony of the long bus ride.
monotony.zh: 音樂打破了漫長搭車過程的單調感。

monster.en: The children drew a friendly monster for the storytelling activity.
monster.zh: 孩子們為說故事活動畫了一隻友善怪物。

monstrous.en: The novel describes a monstrous shadow moving across the empty hall.
monstrous.zh: 小說描述一道可怕巨大影子掠過空蕩大廳。

monthly.en: The club publishes a monthly newsletter about upcoming school events.
monthly.zh: 社團每月出版一份介紹近期校園活動的通訊。

monument.en: Visitors gathered near the monument to learn about local history.
monument.zh: 遊客聚集在紀念碑附近了解在地歷史。

mood.en: Soft music changed the mood of the room almost immediately.
mood.zh: 柔和音樂幾乎立刻改變了房間氣氛。

moody.en: The weather was moody, shifting from sunshine to rain quickly.
moody.zh: 天氣變化不定，很快從晴天轉成下雨。

moon.en: The full moon appeared above the hills after sunset.
moon.zh: 日落後，滿月出現在山丘上方。

mop.en: We used a mop to clean the wet classroom floor.
mop.zh: 我們用拖把清理教室潮濕的地板。

moral.en: The story raises a moral question about honesty and responsibility.
moral.zh: 這個故事提出關於誠實與責任的道德問題。

morale.en: The team's morale improved after they solved the difficult problem.
morale.zh: 團隊解決難題後，士氣提升了。

morality.en: The philosophy class discussed morality through several everyday examples.
morality.zh: 哲學課透過幾個日常例子討論道德。

moreover.en: The plan is affordable; moreover, it can be completed quickly.
moreover.zh: 這項計畫費用合理，而且還能很快完成。

mortal.en: Ancient myths often describe gods interacting with mortal people.
mortal.zh: 古代神話常描述神祇與凡人互動。

mortality.en: The report compares mortality rates across different historical periods.
mortality.zh: 這份報告比較不同歷史時期的死亡率。

mortgage.en: The finance lesson explained how a mortgage works over many years.
mortgage.zh: 財經課說明房貸如何在多年期間運作。

mosquito.en: A mosquito buzzed near the window during the warm evening.
mosquito.zh: 溫暖的晚上，一隻蚊子在窗邊嗡嗡飛。

mostly.en: The audience was mostly students from nearby senior high schools.
mostly.zh: 觀眾大多是附近高中的學生。

motel.en: The travelers stayed at a small motel beside the highway.
motel.zh: 旅客住在公路旁的一間小汽車旅館。

moth.en: A pale moth circled the porch light after sunset.
moth.zh: 日落後，一隻淡色飛蛾繞著門廊燈飛。

motherhood.en: The interview explored how motherhood changed her daily priorities.
motherhood.zh: 這場訪談探討成為母親如何改變她的日常優先順序。

motion.en: The physics experiment measured the motion of a rolling ball.
motion.zh: 物理實驗測量一顆滾動球的運動。

motivate.en: Clear goals can motivate students to practice more consistently.
motivate.zh: 明確目標可以激勵學生更規律練習。

motivation.en: Her motivation increased after she saw steady improvement in reading.
motivation.zh: 看到閱讀能力穩定進步後，她的學習動機提高了。

motor.en: The small motor powered the model car across the table.
motor.zh: 小型馬達驅動模型車穿過桌面。

motorcycle.en: A motorcycle passed slowly through the narrow village street.
motorcycle.zh: 一輛機車慢慢通過狹窄的村莊街道。

motto.en: The school's motto encourages curiosity, responsibility, and lifelong learning.
motto.zh: 校訓鼓勵好奇心、責任感與終身學習。

mound.en: A small mound of soil formed beside the garden path.
mound.zh: 花園小徑旁形成了一小堆土。

mount.en: The museum will mount the photograph inside a protective frame.
mount.zh: 博物館會把照片裝裱在保護框中。

mountainous.en: The mountainous region has winding roads and scattered villages.
mountainous.zh: 這個山區有蜿蜒道路與分散的村落。
